description.value: Britannia Brewing Co is a craft brewery with taprooms across the Lower Mainland and Okanagan, producing a nautically themed lineup of ales, lagers, and sours. The Richmond presence is described on the website as a bar and restaurant in Steveston Village, a historic fishing village popular with cyclists riding the Steveston Dyke trail. The brewery's range spans sessionable lagers and blond ales through hoppy IPAs and dark porters.

raw_osm.description: Real opening hours are different from the one posted on the sign outside. If gate is locked, call the brewery.
raw_osm.name: Britannia Brewing

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Britannia Brewing Co operates three BC locations including a Richmond bar & restaurant labeled 'Steveston Village,' and the phone number (273-9379) matches the OSM record exactly. However, the OSM address (12500 Horseshoe Way, Unit 110) sits in an industrial area of Richmond that does not correspond to Steveston Village; an OSM note also warns that posted hours are inaccurate and the gate may be locked, suggesting this node may represent the production facility rather than the public taproom. No amenity details relevant to cyclists (bike parking, washrooms, water) appear anywhere on the website.
